body.prompt: An American woman in her mid forties kneeling in a small apartment in the evening beside an empty dog bed, holding a worn red leash in both hands, soft lamp light, quiet grief. Absolutely no text, no letters, no numbers, no readable screens, no watermark, no brands anywhere.
